<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Adoption;

use Symfony\AI\Agent\Toolbox\Attribute\AsTool;
use Symfony\AI\AiBundle\Security\Attribute\IsGrantedTool;
use Symfony\AI\Platform\Tool\ToolEffectHints;

#[AsTool('publication_read', 'Read the ID and title of a published article by integer ID.',
    method: 'read', effectHints: new ToolEffectHints(readOnlyHint: true),
    metadata: ['code_mode.output_schema' => [
        'type' => 'object', 'required' => ['id', 'title'], 'additionalProperties' => false,
        'properties' => ['id' => ['type' => 'integer'], 'title' => ['type' => 'string']],
    ]])]
// This second tool deliberately remains outside the Code Mode allowlist.
#[AsTool('publication_count', 'Count published articles.', method: 'count', effectHints: new ToolEffectHints(readOnlyHint: true))]
final class ArticleTool
{
    public function __construct(private readonly ArticleCatalog $articles) {}

    /** @return array{id: int, title: string} */
    #[IsGrantedTool(ArticleVoter::READ, subject: 'id')]
    public function read(int $id): array { return $this->articles->readPublished($id); }

    public function count(): int { return 1; }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Adoption;

use Symfony\Component\Security\Core\Authentication\Token\TokenInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Security\Core\Authorization\Voter\Voter;

/** One application policy for controller access, catalog discovery and native AI tool execution. */
final class ArticleVoter extends Voter
{
    public const DISCOVER = 'PUBLICATION_DISCOVER';
    public const READ = 'PUBLICATION_READ';

    public function __construct(private readonly ArticleCatalog $articles, private readonly DemoReaderAccess $access) {}

    protected function supports(string $attribute, mixed $subject): bool
    {
        // Route attributes are strings; native tool arguments have already been typed.
        return (self::DISCOVER === $attribute && null === $subject)
            || (self::READ === $attribute && (is_int($subject) || is_string($subject))
                && false !== filter_var($subject, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, ['options' => ['min_range' => 1]]));
    }

    protected function voteOnAttribute(string $attribute, mixed $subject, TokenInterface $token): bool
    {
        // Re-read the application's permission fixture even when a token/contract was already loaded.
        return 'demo-reader' === $token->getUserIdentifier() && in_array('ROLE_READER', $token->getRoleNames(), true)
            && $this->access->isGranted() && (self::DISCOVER === $attribute || $this->articles->isPublished((int) $subject));
    }
}

namespace Adoption;

use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\JsonResponse;
use Symfony\Component\Security\Http\Attribute\IsGranted;

final readonly class ArticleController
{
    public function __construct(private ArticleCatalog $articles) {}

        return new JsonResponse($this->articles->readPublished($id));

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CodeMode\Symfony\Profiler;

use Symfony\Contracts\Service\ResetInterface;

/** Bounded request-local diagnostics. Never stores identities, arguments, results or exception messages. */
final class CatalogTrace implements ResetInterface
{
    private array $operations = [];
    private ?int $active = null;
    private int $dropped = 0;

    public function begin(string $operation): void
    {
        if (count($this->operations) >= 32) { $this->active = null; ++$this->dropped; return; }
        $this->operations[] = ['operation' => $operation, 'status' => 'running', 'budget' => [], 'calls' => [], 'nativeEvents' => []];
        $this->active = array_key_last($this->operations);
    }

    public function budget(array $state, string $phase): void
    {
        if (null === $this->active || count($this->operations[$this->active]['budget']) >= 4) { return; }
        $this->operations[$this->active]['budget'][] = ['phase' => $phase,
            'attempts' => (int) ($state['executions'] ?? 0), 'reservedCalls' => (int) ($state['toolCalls'] ?? 0),
            'knownContracts' => count($state['described'] ?? [])];
    }

    public function ledger(array $trace): void
    {
        if (null === $this->active) { return; }
        foreach (array_slice($trace['toolCalls'] ?? [], 0, 100) as $call) {
            $row = ['name' => self::name($call['name'] ?? ''), 'status' => self::name($call['status'] ?? 'unknown')];
            if (isset($call['reason'])) { $row['reason'] = self::name($call['reason']); }
            if (isset($call['durationMs'])) { $row['durationMs'] = round((float) $call['durationMs'], 3); }
            $this->operations[$this->active]['calls'][] = $row;
        }
    }

    public function nativeEvent(string $name, string $phase): void
    {
        if (null === $this->active) { return; }
        if (count($this->operations[$this->active]['nativeEvents']) >= 400) { ++$this->dropped; return; }
        $this->operations[$this->active]['nativeEvents'][] = ['name' => self::name($name), 'phase' => $phase];
    }

    public function finish(array $value, bool $failed, float $durationMs): void
    {
        if (null === $this->active) { return; }
        $row = &$this->operations[$this->active];
        $row['status'] = $failed ? 'failed' : 'succeeded';
        $row['durationMs'] = round($durationMs, 3);
        if ($failed) { $row['reason'] = self::name($value['error']['reason'] ?? 'tool_failed'); }
        if ('search_tools' === $row['operation'] && !$failed) {
            $row['discovery'] = ['matched' => (int) ($value['matched'] ?? 0), 'returned' => (int) ($value['returned'] ?? 0),
                'truncated' => (bool) ($value['truncated'] ?? false)];
        }
        $this->active = null;
    }

    public function snapshot(): array { return ['operations' => $this->operations, 'dropped' => $this->dropped]; }
    public function reset(): void { $this->operations = []; $this->active = null; $this->dropped = 0; }
    private static function name(string $value): string
    {
        return preg_match('/\A[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{0,63}\z/D', $value) ? $value : '[redacted]';
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CodeMode\Symfony\Profiler;

use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\{Request, Response};
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\DataCollector\DataCollector;

final class CatalogDataCollector extends DataCollector
{
    public function __construct(private readonly CatalogTrace $trace) {}
    public function collect(Request $request, Response $response, ?\Throwable $exception = null): void { $this->data = $this->trace->snapshot(); }
    public function getName(): string { return 'code_mode'; }
    public function getOperations(): array { return $this->data['operations'] ?? []; }
    public function getDropped(): int { return $this->data['dropped'] ?? 0; }
    public function reset(): void { $this->data = []; $this->trace->reset(); }
}
